newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan says no retreat if banks-commerce mixed.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan says no retreat if banks-commerce mixed.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Thursday urged careful, incremental moves to combine U.S. banking and commercial activities, noting that the process, once started, will be irreversible.

"I don't see any conceivable possibility that if the Congress moves forward in a manner to break the barriers between banking and finance ... that there's a way of retreating if it is perceived to have been the less-than-optimum model," Greenspan said in testimony to the House Banking Committee.
The Fed chairman called for creation of a model for combining banking and other financial services first, which could later be applied to other commercial activities.

"We have the time to make the right judgments and I think there's no reason why we shouldn't wait and see how the first tranche of this system goes, where we move to financial modernization with financial institutions including insurance first," Greenspan added.
